units.source_text: 道子换了一副新的面孔。

en.t: Michiko had taken on a new face.

units.source_text: 澡堂里没有口红，也没有白粉。

en.t: There was no lipstick in the bathhouse, and no face powder either.

units.source_text: 她什么也没带到走廊上。

en.t: She had brought nothing with her out into the corridor.

units.source_text: 清早的肌肤本是苍黄色，这会儿却变得洁白了。

en.t: Her skin, which in the early morning had been a sallow yellow, had now turned clear and white.

units.source_text: 脸颊第一次飞起了红晕，活像抹了两个圆圆的红圈。

en.t: For the first time, a flush rose in her cheeks, just like two round circles of rouge had been painted there.
The invalid had become a young girl.

units.source_text: 她大概一直想着朝仓在寺院时所说的事，露出了一副郁闷的脸色。

en.t: She was probably still thinking about what Asakura had said at the temple, and her face looked troubled.

units.source_text: 从寺院出来时没有梳理的头发，浴后梳得整整齐齐。

en.t: Her hair, which had been uncombed when she left the temple, was neatly arranged after her bath.

units.source_text: 眉毛、眼睛和嘴巴的轮廓也分明起来，恍如各自孤零零地分开似的，总觉得有点迷迷惘惘。

en.t: The outlines of her brows, eyes, and mouth also became distinct, as if each stood apart on its own, giving her a somewhat dazed and uncertain look.
